prose: The Wall Street Journal reports that surging demand from AI hyperscalers has quintupled flash memory prices and shifted negotiating power from Apple to suppliers such as Kioxia. The iPhone maker spent years bullying flash-storage makers into steep discounts until hyperscalers bid up prices and absorbed the supply.
highlights: AI hyperscaler demand has quintupled flash memory prices
Market and negotiating power shifts from Apple to suppliers like Kioxia
Apple previously extracted steep discounts from flash-storage makers
